summary: Underneath it, a strong will and deep reserves of energy and a longing for something more and a soft, porous edge are fused in you — you can't run one without the other. At your best, you go after what you want and don't back down and you imagine, feel for others, and create. At the edge, your temper gets ahead of you, or you sit on it until it leaks out sideways.
